definition: Zvi Mowshowitz is an American writer and member of the rationalist community who primarily discusses new developments in artificial intelligence.
details: He is a former competitive Magic: The Gathering player and was CEO of MetaMed. He was inducted into the Magic Hall of Fame in 2007.

explainer.lead: Zvi Mowshowitz is an American writer and Magic: The Gathering player.

contributions.name: He co-founded and was the CEO of MetaMed, a medical research analysis firm, which shut down in 2015.
He was developing a blockchain game, Emergents, in 2020.
He also founded Balsa Research, a nonprofit think tank which advocated for the repeal of the Jones Act, increasing the housing supply, and reform of the National Environmental Policy Act.
In 2023, Mowshowitz wrote an article for Vox on the topic of AI safety.
